messages:
Noah: Hi all — first day! Unboxed my M2 Pro and did MDM enroll. Two quick things: 1) I can't sudo even though my user says "Standard" -> the laptop dropdown had my SSO email and a local user. 2) Where do I put my SSH public key so I can push to internal repos?

IT Support: Welcome Noah! For sudo we grant local admin only after you finish the profile approvals. Can you run `profiles status -type enrollment` and `id -Gn` and paste outputs?

Noah: profiles shows Enrolled and one config profile "Redwood Device Management" pending user approval. `id -Gn` returns: staff everyone. No admin group.

DevEx: For SSH keys we use the Git provisioning flow. Upload your public key at https://internal.redwood.ai/ssh-keys (SSO required) and the repo perms team will map it to your username. If you're blocked we can temporarily add a deploy key to a repo for testing.

Noah: Thanks. Is the SSH page per-user or per-device? I want to use my work laptop key and keep my personal key separate.

DevEx: Per-user. You can upload multiple keys and name them (e.g., "noah-laptop-2026"). Keys get tied to your SSO identity.

IT Support: About sudo — that pending profile is why. I can push a one-time admin elevation so you can approve the profile and complete the setup. Would you like that now?

Noah: Yes please. Also while we're at it, any guidance on switching to the local admin temporarily to install Homebrew packages?

IT Support: We usually provide temporary admin for package installs. Please list the packages you need and we'll scope the elevation for 1 hour. Revoke is automatic.

Noah: Need git, docker, and awscli. We'll only install via brew.

Ops Bot: Temporary admin granted to Noah for 60 minutes (ticket #IT-4321).

Noah: Got it. Approved profile, installer asked for Keychain access when trusting certs  selected Always Allow.

IT Support: Good. Now reboot and run `fdesetup status` and `profiles status -type configuration` then paste outputs.

Noah: After reboot: `fdesetup status` => FileVault is On for the disk. `profiles` => All profiles installed 1 no pending user approval.

Security Eng: Quick check  confirm the profile issuer is "redwood-device-ca" and cert SAN contains "device.redwood.ai" before installing any VPN agents.

Noah: Confirmed issuer and SAN look correct. VPN client installed fine.

IT Support: Revoking temp admin now. You should still be able to use Homebrew packages installed while admin, but not sudo going forward. If you need recurring admin for a CI runner or similar, create a ticket with justification.

Noah: Uploaded my public key to the SSH page and can clone the internal repo now. Thanks for the quick help!

DevEx: Welcome aboard, Noah. Ping here if you want pairing on the repo access or dotfiles. :rocket:
